I’m committed to ending this administration’s disastrous war of choice in Iran and bringing down prices for Americans who deserve real relief.

With a strong Democratic majority, I’ll fight to check the Trump Administration’s attacks on our community and to make life more affordable. That means bringing film & TV jobs back home, lowering prices, building more housing, ending forever wars, and building a government that works for all Americans, not just the billionaires. The California Secretary of State Voter Hotline is available to report denial of voting rights or answer questions about voting. Call (800) 345-VOTE (8683) or email elections@sos.ca.gov. 

Your vote is your voice, so make sure it is heard!

California law protects every voter. Federal monitors sent to observe the election, including those from the Department of Justice, must follow state election law. They cannot intimidate voters, interfere with voting, or get in the way of the state and local officials administering elections. 

Here’s the full California Voter Bill of Rights at https://t.co/81HpT1BlEB.

This October, we’re honoring the brave icons who faced hatred with love, and forged ahead to fight for equal rights for all.

Now boarding at the new @fly_BUR terminal!  

As an airport commissioner, I helped build support for this badly needed project. In Congress, I serve on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, which oversees millions in funding to support projects like this. We all loved the old terminal, but this safer, more spacious, modern terminal will find its way into your heart.

This is a wake-up call. Our social media is being manipulated by foreign agents with the express intention of sowing hatred, mistrust, and misinformation among Americans.

Russia is behind a lot of it, using programs designed to disrupt our country and turn us against each other. We should be cynical about what we see on social media, and not fall for the rage bait.

This is also a national security issue and if the social media companies dont take immediate action, they are complicit. It's time for real regulation that requires them to find and shut down foreign bot networks, and holds them accountable when they don't.

Today, we honor and celebrate Indigenous Peoples’ Day and the countless contributions Indigenous communities make in Los Angeles and across our nation.

If you would like to learn more about Los Angeles’ Indigenous peoples, check out The Autry Museum in my district. It holds one of the largest collections of Indigenous art and artifacts and is one of our most prized cultural institutions.

Today is National Coming Out Day. To those of you who have come out, haven’t yet, or can’t, know that I will always support you. As your ally in Congress, I’m fighting for a future where you can live your most authentic life, free from discrimination and hatred.

Thank you to @IATSE, @sagaftra, the @directorsguild, the @WGAWest, the @Teamsters, and LiLUNA for standing with me as well as @senadamschiff, @replindasanchez, @repmaxinewaters, @repjudychu, @RepPeteAguilar, @reptedlieu, @CongressMin, @RepDerekTranCA, Mayor @ArdyKassakhian, and the @producersguild. Let’s bring these jobs home.

🧵 When a production leaves this country, the movie still gets made. The stars still work. The crew is who gets left behind.

Today, I brought every major production union and nine of my colleagues to Glendale to say enough. Sixty-five countries offer incentives to steal our film and TV jobs. America offers nothing.

The clock is ticking to turn in your service academy nomination applications in order to be considered in this cycle!

Don’t hesitate to reach out to my office if you have any questions about eligibility, test scores, or materials you need to submit, and best of luck to all! https://t.co/JIIxzR1FSN

The unions and studios that make American film and TV are backing our bipartisan national film tax credit: IATSE, SAG-AFTRA, the Teamsters, DGA, WGA, and so many more.

It's a 20%-30% tax credit on American labor for productions that shoot here, built to bring back the jobs we've lost overseas.

Education unlocks doors and lifts entire families up. That's why I’m proud to fight for better access to public education and educational opportunities for all Americans.

From my Education Advisory Committee to my rallies with local parents and teachers and defending Head Start, you can count on me to fight for our children’s education.

We have created a strong coalition and a ton of momentum around the bipartisan film tax credit bill I and a bipartisan group of my colleagues introduced.

Read more about the rally I led with our local production unions and Members of Congress in Variety:

https://t.co/H2z4xjIycP

Lightsabers, Davy Jones’ heart, and Agammemnon’s armor – some of the most iconic things you remember from movies, TV shows, and video games were made by local prop houses like @Thingergy in Burbank.

In Congress, I’m fighting to get our bipartisan national film and TV tax credit bill passed ASAP, so that we can generate more economic investment for local businesses.

Trump's team says there's not enough money to fund air traffic control upgrades.

Great news: I found some. $85 billion for ICE. $47 billion and counting on Trump's Iran War.

Happy to help them reprioritize. https://t.co/PBUylnpRke

FACT CHECK: Secretary Duffy says Congress didn’t fund air traffic control.

Republicans’ own bill gave ICE $75 BILLION. Air traffic control got $12.5 billion.

There’s money. It’s a question of priorities. https://t.co/fT9OXbDiJz
